**Is your request about an existing chapter?**
If so, give its title or URL, and describe what would improve it.

E.g. Data literacy, Data visualisation, Statistical methods or Coding skills.

**Additional context**
Are there similar tutorials elsewhere? Links to them, Stack Overflow posts, GitHub issues and the like are welcome.
